ai.literal: Tools and, time and, method of action and, the difficult deed to be done and - that which is excellent (in these) is the minister.
ai.translation: A minister is one who excels in assessing the tools, the time, the method of execution, and the difficult task to be accomplished.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்வதற்கான கருவிகள், தகுந்த காலம், செயல்படும் முறை, மற்றும் செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டிய அரிய செயல் ஆகிய நான்கிலும் சிறந்து விளங்குபவரே அமைச்சர் ஆவார்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of a successful minister. It lists four critical factors for state action: the necessary tools or resources, the right time, the proper method of execution, and the difficult task to be done. The word 'மாண்டது' denotes excellence or mastery. Thus, a true minister is one who demonstrates absolute mastery in coordinating these four elements to achieve challenging goals.

ai.literal: Courage, subjects protecting, having learned knowing, with effort, five together that which is excellent [is] ministry.
ai.translation: A ministry is that which possesses excellence in these five qualities together: courage, protecting the subjects, learning, understanding, and industriousness.
ai.modern: அஞ்சாமை, குடிமக்களைக் காத்தல், நூல்களைக் கற்றல், அறிய வேண்டியவற்றை அறிதல், விடாமுயற்சி ஆகிய ஐந்தும் ஒருங்கே சிறப்பாக அமைந்ததே அமைச்சாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the five essential qualities that make up an excellent minister or ministry. The word 'வன்கண்' can sometimes mean harshness or cruelty, but in the context of statecraft here, it means the courage and firm resolve needed to govern and face challenges. The other qualities are protecting the people ('குடி காத்தல்'), acquiring knowledge ('கற்று'), understanding situations clearly ('அறிதல்'), and tireless effort ('ஆள்வினை'). The phrase 'ஐந்துடன் மாண்டது' emphasizes that true ministerial excellence requires all five of these traits to be present together.

ai.literal: Separating and, cherishing keeping and, those who separated uniting and, that which is capable (is) minister.
ai.translation: A minister is one who is capable of dividing foes, cherishing and keeping allies, and reuniting those who have separated.
ai.modern: பகைவர்களைப் பிரிப்பதும், நண்பர்களைப் பாதுகாத்துத் தன்னுடனே வைத்துக் கொள்வதும், பிரிந்து சென்றவர்களை மீண்டும் சேர்த்து வைப்பதும் ஆகிய செயல்களில் வல்லவரே அமைச்சர் ஆவார்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the core diplomatic capabilities of a minister. The word 'பிரித்தலும்' refers to the ability to separate enemies from their allies. 'பேணிக் கொளலும்' means carefully maintaining existing alliances. Finally, 'பிரிந்தார் பொருத்தலும்' highlights the skill of reconciling and reuniting with those who have previously estranged themselves. A true minister ('அமைச்சு') is one who is capable ('வல்லது') of executing all these three strategies effectively.

ai.literal: Examining and, having deliberated doing and, decisively saying and, that which is capable (is) ministry.
ai.translation: The ministry is that which is capable of examining a matter, deliberating before acting, and advising decisively.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலை நன்கு ஆராய்தலும், ஆராய்ந்த பின் அதனைச் செய்தலும், உறுதியாக ஆலோசனை கூறுதலும் ஆகிய திறன்களை உடையதே அமைச்சாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the core capabilities required of a minister. The word 'terital' refers to examining a situation thoroughly, while 'tērntu ceyal' means executing a task after careful deliberation. The phrase 'orutalaiyā collal' emphasizes the ability to give firm, decisive advice without ambiguity, choosing 'orutalai' in its sense of certainty rather than partiality. Together, these three qualities of analysis, deliberate action, and decisive counsel constitute true ministerial competence.

ai.literal: Having known virtue, fully fitting he of words, any time-even, ability he who knows, deliberation companion.
ai.translation: He who understands virtue, speaks mature and fitting words, and always knows the right way to act, is the ideal companion for deliberation.
ai.modern: அறத்தை அறிந்து, முழுமையாகப் பொருந்திய சொற்களைப் பேசுபவனாய், எக்காலத்திலும் செயலின் தன்மையை அறிந்தவனே ஆராய்ந்து முடிவெடுக்க ஏற்ற துணையாவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of an ideal counselor. The phrase 'அறனறிந்து ஆன்றமைந்த சொல்லான்' describes a person who understands virtue and speaks mature, fitting words. 'எஞ்ஞான்றும் திறன் அறிந்தான்' refers to someone who consistently knows the practical nature of any situation. Such a well-rounded and articulate person is the perfect companion ('தேர்ச்சித் துணை') for a leader when deliberating important decisions.

ai.literal: Sharpness of intellect with learning to those who possess, extreme subtlety what are there before things that stand?
ai.translation: What highly subtle obstacles can stand before those who possess a naturally sharp intellect combined with the knowledge of books?
ai.modern: இயற்கையான அறிவுக் கூர்மையோடு நூலறிவையும் உடையவர்களுக்கு, அவர்கள் முன் எதிர்த்து நிற்கக்கூடிய மிக நுட்பமான தடைகள் எவை உள்ளன?
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the unbeatable combination of innate intelligence and acquired knowledge. 'Mati-nuṭpam' refers to a naturally sharp mind, while 'nūl' represents formal learning. When a person possesses both, no problem or plot, no matter how extremely subtle ('ati-nuṭpam'), can stand in their way. The rhetorical question emphasizes that such a well-equipped mind can unravel any complexity.

ai.literal: Theoretical method known even when, of the world nature having known act.
ai.translation: Even if you know the theoretical methods for a task, you must understand the practical nature of the world before acting.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்யும் முறைகளை முழுமையாக அறிந்திருந்தாலும், உலகத்தின் நடைமுறை இயல்பை நன்கு அறிந்து அதற்கேற்பச் செயல்பட வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet contrasts theoretical knowledge with practical wisdom. The word 'செயற்கை' refers to the artificial or theoretical methods of doing things, often learned from study. 'இயற்கை' refers to the natural state or practical reality of the world. The poet advises that even if a minister has mastered the theoretical methods of governance, they must observe and understand the actual conditions of the world before taking action.

ai.literal: Knowledge having destroyed, he knows not even if, benefit, beside he who is, speaking is duty.
ai.translation: Even if the leader destroys good sense and remains stubbornly ignorant, it is the duty of the one beside him to speak what is beneficial.
ai.modern: அறிவை அழித்துவிட்டு எதையும் அறியாதவராகத் தலைவர் இருந்தாலும், அவருக்கு நன்மையானவற்றை எடுத்துச் சொல்வதே அருகில் இருக்கும் அமைச்சரின் கடமையாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the unwavering duty of a minister. The phrase 'அறிகொன்று அறியான்' describes a leader who actively rejects good sense and remains stubbornly ignorant. Even in such frustrating circumstances, the minister, denoted by 'உழையிருந்தான்' (the one who is beside), must not give up. Their fundamental duty ('கடன்') is to continue speaking words of true benefit ('உறுதி') to guide the leader.

ai.literal: Ruin plotting than a minister by the side, enemy a seventy crore is better.
ai.translation: It is better to face seventy crore open enemies than to have a minister by one's side who secretly plots ruin.
ai.modern: தனக்குக் கேடு விளைவிக்க நினைக்கும் அமைச்சர் தன் பக்கத்தில் இருப்பதை விட, எழுபது கோடி எதிரிகளைப் பெற்றிருப்பது மேலானது.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the extreme danger of a treacherous advisor. The phrase 'பழுது எண்ணும்' describes a minister who secretly plots harm or ruin against their own leader. The word 'தெவ்' means enemy, and the poet uses the massive number 'ஓர் எழுபது கோடி' (seventy crores) to represent an overwhelming external threat. The verb 'உறும்' indicates that facing this unimaginable number of open enemies is preferable. The core message is that an internal threat disguised as a trusted minister is far more destructive than any external force.

ai.literal: Methodically even having deliberated, completion things-without-indeed they will do, competence those who lack.
ai.translation: Even after deliberating methodically, those who lack the competence to execute will only perform actions that remain incomplete.
ai.modern: செயல்படுத்தும் திறமை இல்லாதவர்கள், ஒரு செயலை முறையாகச் சிந்தித்துத் தொடங்கினாலும், அதனை முடிக்க முடியாமல் அரைகுறையாகவே செய்வார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the crucial difference between planning and execution. The root 'சூழ்' generally means to surround, but in the context of ministry and counsel, it takes the sense of deliberating or considering an issue from all sides. The word 'முறைப்பட' emphasizes that this deliberation was done methodically. However, 'திறப்பாடு' refers to the practical ability or competence to carry out a task. The couplet states that without this practical competence, even the best-laid plans will result in actions that have no 'முடிவு' (completion), meaning they will be left unfinished.
